boards.name: 한손검
boards.weapon: practical straight steel one-handed sword with navy leather grip, simple silver guard, no shield
boards.attack_brief: right-handed low ready with tip diagonally forward; draw sword back beside right shoulder; step into one controlled diagonal forward cut to the right; follow-through with tip lowered away from others
boards.victory_brief: lower sword safely; exhale with a hand briefly against chest; glance toward companions and offer a small relieved smile, no blade salute
boards.prompt: Create ONE LANDSCAPE combat ANIMATION KEY-POSE REFERENCE SHEET for AEL, original fantasy JRPG Springbound Frontier. Warm ivory background, thin understated grid lines and a small clear header. EXACTLY TWO ROWS of SIX equally sized cells, 12 full-body sprites TOTAL; generous transparent-looking ivory padding, no figures cut off, no poses overlap cells. Row1 columns 1-6: FRONT READY, RIGHT SIDE READY, BACK READY, RIGHT-SIDE ATTACK ANTICIPATION, RIGHT-SIDE ATTACK CONTACT, RIGHT-SIDE FOLLOW-THROUGH. Small simple English labels beneath cells. Standing feet share exact same baseline and body scale. Camera is fixed slight elevated game view. Only intentional attack footwork, no arbitrary vertical bouncing. One same weapon across all cells. No enemies, no scenery, no big shadows, no damage numbers or visual effects, no extra portraits. Sheet is a pose reference, not claimed as finished animated atlas. Character is earnest and caring, initially nervous and learning, not an arrogant master warrior. TITLE AEL / 한손검. WEAPON: practical straight steel one-handed sword with navy leather grip, simple silver guard, no shield. Attack staging: right-handed low ready with tip diagonally forward; draw sword back beside right shoulder; step into one controlled diagonal forward cut to the right; follow-through with tip lowered away from others. The three consecutive victory key poses must express: lower sword safely; exhale with a hand briefly against chest; glance toward companions and offer a small relieved smile, no blade salute. His right hand is the weapon hand except bow where left holds bow and right draws; BACK view must preserve anatomy not mirror equipment randomly.
